title: The Visual Iconicity Challenge: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Sign Language Form–Meaning Mapping

bias_targets.target: Static visual bias (Object vs. Action bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Comparing VLM iconicity ratings for object-based signs versus action-based signs to detect if models systematically over-value static visual resemblance (objects) while under-attending to dynamic human actions, contrasting with the human baseline action bias.

Evaluating models on a 'sign transparency' task (inferring meaning solely from visual form without textual context) to test if the models genuinely ground their understanding in the dynamic visual signal rather than relying on text-based priors.

primary_bias_target: Static visual bias (Object vs. Action bias)
